p.i: Cum[?] hi commentarii Roberti Rolloci in utramque epistolam Pauli ad Theffalonicenfes, una cum ana-lysi epistola ad Philemonem, á Corvino typogra-pho noftro Profefforibus illuftris hujus fchola, ut ejufdem leges jubent, exhibiti effent, antequam eos jam antea Edinburgi in Scotia excufos typis fuis imitaretur: ego illos pro officii mei ratione diligenter & attente perlegi, dignosque judi-cavi (ficut & collega mei) ut per Corvini prelum cum noftris hominibus communicarentur; ita tamen fi paffim adjiceren-tur nota quaedam, quibus ftudiofus veritatis caleftis lector de nonnullis breviter admoneretur. Quae quidem nota ut candide & fimplici veritatis caleftis propaganda ftudio à me funt an-notata: ita velim eas in optimam partem ab omnibus, ac in-primis ab ipfo horum commentariorum authore accipi. Cujus mentem fi forte uspiam non videbor effe affecutus: gratum mi-hi & alius erit, fi ipfe eam plenius & clarius expofuerit. Etfi au-tem fortaffe aquum & authori gratum fuiffet, fi has notas pri-vatim cum ipfo communicaffem, ut ipfemet illa de quibus le-ctorem admoneo, fi videretur, immutaret: tamen quoniam istud propter loci longinquitatem intra breve tempus fieri non potuit, hanc viam ingredi rectius duxi; ut tam docta atq; uti-les lucubrationes quamprimùm in nostrorum hominum ma-nus pervenirent. Porro quam libertatem mihi hic in alieno capere sumsi, eandem in meis opusculis adhibeti ab aliis, pergra-tum mihi effet.

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated box; its letter is read as C, which is doubtful, hence [?]. "lectorem" line-break reading and "cavi(ficut" bracket are uncertain. The word "capere" in the last-but-one line is partly cut at the left edge of the scan, and "adhibeti" is printed as shown. The right edge of the scan is cropped, so words at the right of lines 1 to 25 may be incomplete; the readings above follow what is visible. Printed "s" forms are given as plain s. The printer's ornament above the title and the bullet below the text are not text and are omitted.
